data.narrative:
Cellino, a Series A biotech company founded by Nabiha Saklayen and Marinna Madrid, has raised approximately $125M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a universe of 3 public comparables in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Of three valuation methods considered, only stage-progression analysis proved applicable. This method uses the $125M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement to the subsequent funding round, yielding an implied valuation of $250M. Peer-median analysis could not be applied due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparable datapoints within the narrow peer set—while 7 total Biotech & Health peers exist in the dataset, fewer than 3 met filtering criteria. Public-comp anchoring using the sector's 6.2x P/S median (across the 3 public tickers) could not be executed because Cellino's revenue is not disclosed, which is typical for private companies at this stage.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $212M to $288M, with a median point of $250M. This analysis carries material uncertainty due to reliance on a single method; peer benchmarking would strengthen conviction if comparable valuation data becomes available. Stage-specific funding multiples and sector-wide market conditions remain key sensitivities.
